Since the haven audit keeps both texts, an operator that cannot answer again loses everything it earned, which is a cost that falls only on fabricated work. Each close, 32% of settled answers are re-asked under a fresh nonce, and a failed re-ask claws back the original reward. That is 33 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
